name: eigen-stem
description: Calm and gentle voice. The owner's own voice (recording 'Beste voice ever', 11 Nov 2026; owner: 'Van mezelf'), cloned with OmniVoice with the owner's permission. Reference = first 15.9 s of that recording; only on the owner's pc (ref_pc), not on GitHub (public repo). Speed 1.0 = his natural pace (± 128 words/min).
ref_text: Tonight, we travel back through time. Imagine a small medieval village, hidden beneath a cold silver moon. The streets are silent. Only the gentle sound of the wind moves through the narrow streets.
